blurb: Wheaton Park Stables has been operating for nearly 60 years and specializes in family-friendly English style riding experiences. They provide group riding lessons, pony rides for young children, guided trail rides, summer camps for ages 3-18, and host special events such as birthday parties and scout activities. Rides and lessons are held in indoor or outdoor arenas and cater to a range of ages and abilities.
extraNote: No reservations needed for pony rides except for groups greater than 3 kids; all group lessons require commitment to 12 weeks · Up to two make-ups per session for missed group riding classes, must be scheduled within session · Lessons generally held despite inclement weather unless roads are unsafe or temperatures extreme; cancellations posted on website or Facebook · Cash, check, or Venmo (with 2% service fee)
